ticker: Nasdaq faces massive October rout amid AI spending concerns
Canada and EU form new strategic alliance to counter US
Binance recovers 90 percent of funds from major cyber hack
Bangladesh dengue death toll continues rising into winter months
Quad nations announce 85 million dollar initiative for AI access

articles.headline: Nasdaq faces record wipeout as AI spending fears deepen
articles.brief: Global markets experience heavy tech volatility as investors grow increasingly concerned over massive capital expenditure in artificial intelligence without immediate proportional returns, driving steep index pullbacks.

articles.headline: Canada and EU forge strategic pact to reduce US reliance
articles.brief: Canada and the European Union have officially launched the Alliance for the Future, aiming to boost cooperation in defense, critical minerals, and trade to enhance strategic autonomy amid shifting Washington policies.

articles.headline: Meta partners with Fourier to build advanced humanoid robots
articles.brief: Technology giant Meta is reportedly collaborating with Chinese startup Fourier to develop advanced humanoid robotics, signaling a major push into physical automation and hardware integration.

articles.headline: Binance recovers 90% of funds following massive cyber breach
articles.brief: Cryptocurrency exchange Binance announced it has successfully recovered or covered 90 percent of the massive losses stemming from a historical 6.3 billion dollar security breach.

articles.headline: Bangladesh dengue death toll climbs as crisis persists
articles.brief: Health officials in Bangladesh report a continued surge in fatal dengue cases nationwide, with medical experts warning that the epidemic is unlikely to ease significantly before December.

articles.headline: Quad nations commit funding to expand regional AI access
articles.brief: Leaders of the Quad alliance have announced an 85 million dollar financial package aimed at expanding artificial intelligence access across partner nations while flagging regional economic coercion concerns.

articles.headline: Ukrainian drone maker claims missions succeed without SpaceX
articles.brief: Ukrainian defense manufacturer Fire Point has publicly stated that its domestically produced military systems can successfully complete tactical missions without reliance on SpaceX satellite infrastructure.

articles.headline: Delhi introduces strict winter pollution curbs from November
articles.brief: The Delhi government has announced a comprehensive winter action plan, implementing fifty percent work-from-home mandates, higher parking levies, and stringent vehicle restrictions to combat severe seasonal air pollution.

articles.headline: Indian-American voters shift preferences ahead of US midterms
articles.brief: Recent survey data reveals shifting political alignments among Indian-American voters ahead of upcoming US midterm elections, driven by growing economic anxieties, immigration policy concerns, and foreign relations.

articles.headline: North Korea utilizes sophisticated cyber operations for funds
articles.brief: State-sponsored North Korean hackers continue to leverage advanced social engineering and cryptocurrency exploits to secure vital financial resources, bypassing international economic sanctions to support state priorities.
